auditor_value: (a) bananas move up; (b) gap stays constant; (c) gap stays constant (both in free fall, rope slack); (d) bananas also decelerate/stop exactly as the monkey does

findings.quote: the bananas also move up, matching the monkey step for step.
findings.note: 'step for step' is an idiom; the plain statement is that the bananas rise by the same amount at the same time.
findings.fix: the bananas also move up, rising by the same amount at the same time as the monkey.

notes: Physics of all four parts agrees with my solution: equal tension on both sides of a light rope over a frictionless pulley and equal masses give equal accelerations at every instant, so bananas rise in (a), the gap is constant in (b) and (c) (T = 0 during free fall), and in (d) the bananas decelerate exactly as the monkey does. Qualitative item, no numbers.
